findings.title: subscription.deleted spec stubs sync_with_stripe but never asserts it
findings.spec_requirement: SPEC §9.1: existing branch behavior byte-identical around the insertions (load-bearing clause; 'insertions' plural covers the subscription.deleted branch)
findings.evidence: spec/jobs/stripe_webhook_handler_subscription_events_spec.rb:161 — allow(organization).to receive(:sync_with_stripe) with no have_received(:sync_with_stripe) anywhere in the file. Deleting the branch's `organization&.sync_with_stripe if stripe_subscription_id == organization&.stripe_subscription_id` line would pass the entire suite. The only one of the deleted branch's four existing effects with no coverage (both job enqueues and the subscription_canceled_at write are asserted).
findings.recommendation: Add one have_received(:sync_with_stripe) assertion to the subscription.deleted example, alongside the existing stub. Same class as run 1's l1-a2-001.
